The first 200 photos are of the Totori cosplay. The original creator also included 65 Nyaruko cosplay images as a purchase bonus, which I've uploaded alongside the Totori photos for posterity, despite not knowing or caring what a Nyaruko is.

Sidenote, I think Ryza is overrated as hell, and I wish there were more lewd cosplay photosets of girls from the Arland and Dusk games.
